description: Glass Animals' discography as an archipelago integration where you get checks by listening to music

ga-1.0.0.description:
This is a fully integrated version of the Glass Animals manual, now requiring the use of the Archipelago Music Client. 

To set it up, follow the setup guide [here](https://github.com/benny-dreamly/Archipelago/blob/glassanimals/worlds/glassanimals/docs/setup_en.md) and don't forget to download the zip file, which contains the proper configuration files for setting up this APWorld with the music client. 

The .whl file is not for end users.
ga-1.0.0.title: Glass Animals Discography 1.0.0

ga-1.0.1.description:
This release fixes the home movie tracks being included regardless of them being enabled by the option. The locations were properly gated, but the items weren't. and okay uh the locations were being included too... oh no 

the zip has changed and all files need to be updated. this release is ***incompatible with existing multiworlds***

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/benny-dreamly/Archipelago/compare/ga-1.0.0...ga-1.0.1
ga-1.0.1.title: Glass Animals Discography 1.0.1

ga-1.1.0.description:
This release brings actual UT support, which includes the ability to use UT without a yaml. This has been tested and confirmed to work.

The zip for the configuration files is unchanged from the previous release, however is present as usual for new and returning users.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/benny-dreamly/Archipelago/compare/ga-1.0.1...ga-1.1.0
ga-1.1.0.title: Glass Animals Discography 1.1.0
